combo.description:

combo.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
combo.description:

Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.
